events.quote: The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the respondent has issued a show cause notice in Form DRC 01 on 17.03.2023
Since the petitioner failed to file reply to the said show cause notice, the first respondent has confirmed the proposals contained in the show cause notice and passed the present impugned order.
The challenge in this Writ Petition is to the order dated 19.07.2024 passed by the respondent for the AY 2019-20

defects_argued.quote: Thus, when there is no response from the tax payer to the notice sent through a particular mode, the Officer who is issuing notices should strictly explore the possibilities of sending notices through some other mode as prescribed in Section 169(1) of the Act, preferably by way of RPAD, which would ultimately achieve the object of the GST Act.

In such circumstances, this Court is of the view that the impugned assessment order came to be passed without affording any opportunity of personal hearing to the petitioner, confirming the proposals contained in the show cause notice.

outcome.quote: With the above observations & directions, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
